free_tier_limits.correction: Developer plan is free for eligible teams building on Nordic low-power wireless solutions, covering up to 10 development devices; usage beyond 10 development or production devices is pay-as-you-go.

rate_limits.correction: Rate limits are published and vary by operation; heartbeat ingestion and Latest Release calls are each limited to 100 per device per 24 hours, while session limits depend on the plan and other payload-specific limits apply.

notes: The API remains active in current official documentation. A 404 at the bare API host is expected because it is a base host, not a documented resource. The submitted documentation URL is obsolete; the current REST API reference is /api. No platform shutdown notice was found.
